bottleneck.conclusion: Capacity boundary coincides with a saturated Hikari/MySQL request path and host-wide CPU contention.
ruledOutByCurrentEvidence: JVM GC/heap pressure: low pause increase and modest heap at the boundary.
HTTP 5xx: zero in every capacity run.
MySQL disk-buffer misses/slow queries: both observed deltas were zero.
bottleneck.limitation: No MySQL/Redis container CPU exporter and no usable Tomcat thread metric were available; host CPU cannot be attributed to one process, and Hikari cap versus downstream MySQL CPU cannot be isolated.
